CustomField.description: [Formula field looks to Contact fields to determine what to display] Examples include: Home Phone, Local Phone, Mobile Phone, Email and will show that value. Used by Success Coach users.
CustomField.formula: CASE(Contact.Contact_Preference__c, "Home Phone", Contact.HomePhone, "Local Phone", Contact.OtherPhone, "Mobile Phone", Contact.MobilePhone, "Email", Contact.MobilePhone, "No Preference" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The preferred form of communication based on data on the Contact record in the "Contact Preference" field.
CustomField.label: Contact Preference
